scope: 只读采样，未重启、未修改属性、未停止服务、未执行 adb root。输出保留原始值，设备序列号在命令记录中替换为占位符。

state.command: adb -s <device-serial> shell 'for p in ro.build.version.release ro.build.version.sdk ro.lineage.version ro.build.type ro.zygote init.svc.zygote init.svc.zygote_secondary init.svc.servicemanager sys.boot_completed ro.boottime.init ro.boottime.init.first_stage ro.boottime.init.selinux ro.boottime.zygote zygote.critical_window.minute; do printf "%s=" "$p"; getprop "$p"; done; ps -A -o PID,PPID,NAME,ARGS | grep -E "(^ *1 |zygote64 +zygote64$|zygote +zygote$|system_server +system_server$|servicemanager +servicemanager$)"; cat /proc/1/attr/current'
